text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is one report of acute overdosage with use of an approved injectable testosterone product: this subject had serum testosterone concentrations of up to 11,400 ng/dL with a cerebrovascular accident. Treatment of overdosage would consist of discontinuation of testosterone gel 1%, washing the application site with soap and water, and appropriate symptomatic and supportive care.
